bio.text: Brad Sherman represents California's 32nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he has served since 1997.
He served on the California State Board of Equalization from 1991 to 1996 and was its chairman from 1991 to 1995.
He earned a B.A. from UCLA and a law degree from Harvard, and was born and raised in southern California.
